usage: deskops atoms validate [-h] [--all] [--root ROOT] [doc_id]

positional arguments:
  doc_id       Atom selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or
               unique slug fragment where supported.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --all        Validate all atoms under desk/atoms/.
  --root ROOT  Target repository root.
